comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Sea Monster Hood"

R16 sewing recipe unlocked at Ibn in Alexandria, related to the Sea of Wonders. Ingredients:

Platinum Ore x4
Exquisite Fur x50
Fish-like Phantom Monster's Relic x6

Stats:

Durability 100
Disguise 10
Defense 12

Steering +1
Rowing +2
EX Effect: Increase sailing speed R4

Not to be confused with future alternate color scheme/stat versions:

Sea Monster's Hood
Sea Monster's Hood

Details on them another day, unless someone wishes to enter them for me (you're welcome to do so). Otherwise... cheers.

Pics: yukimiiro.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-635.html

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
It has been confirmed by GMs that all items crafted from Fish-like Phantom Monster's Relic, including this one, are unplunderable. This does not extend to any of Ibn's other available recipes, including Hyper-series cannons.

Credit: [CA]Huseyin_Gazi, [GM]Sheebs
